text: Russia cast the biggest bell in the world. Two hundred and two tonnes. It has never made a single sound. In seventeen thirty-seven, while it was still sitting in its casting pit, the Kremlin caught fire. Guards threw cold water on the red-hot bronze to save it. The outside cooled and shrank. The inside stayed hot and didn't. Cast bronze is brittle, so it cracked, and an eleven and a half tonne slab broke off. It's been on display ever since. The biggest bell on Earth, and nobody has ever heard it ring. Dave was sure he could get one note out of it.
